title: Clean production rebuild + live-only deploy + post-deploy verification for areaworkars.caffeine.ai

requirements.summary: Ensure a forced clean production rebuild clears caches/artifacts and completes successfully with fresh dist/ output.
acceptanceCriteria: A clean rebuild is executed such that prior build artifacts and caches are cleared before building.
The production build finishes successfully and produces fresh build artifacts (e.g., a new dist/ output) with no errors.

file_operations.description: Harden the clean rebuild script to reliably remove common build caches/artifacts (e.g., Vite cache and dist) and run the production build deterministically; ensure it exits non-zero on any failure and prints the expected dist/ location.

Fix and complete the clean rebuild documentation (currently truncated) so it includes the exact command to run the clean rebuild script, what it clears, and how to confirm fresh dist/ artifacts were produced.

requirements.summary: Deploy the clean production build to the live environment only (no draft/preview) for https://areaworkars.caffeine.ai.
acceptanceCriteria: The live deployment completes successfully without creating/publishing a draft/preview deployment.
DNS for areaworkars.caffeine.ai resolves (no NXDOMAIN) and https://areaworkars.caffeine.ai loads the application in a browser after deployment.

file_operations.description: Add a dedicated live-only deployment script that performs (or requires) a clean build artifact and then runs the project’s live deployment command path (explicitly avoiding any preview/draft flags), targeting areaworkars.caffeine.ai.

Fix and complete the live-only deployment documentation (currently truncated) to specify: (1) run clean rebuild, (2) run the live deploy script, (3) explicitly note that preview/draft deploys must not be created/published, and (4) expected live URL https://areaworkars.caffeine.ai.

requirements.summary: Add an explicit post-deploy verification step that checks https://areaworkars.caffeine.ai is reachable and renders the app shell (not blank).
acceptanceCriteria: After the live deploy, an explicit verification is performed against https://areaworkars.caffeine.ai.
Verification confirms the site is reachable and the app renders (not an error page and not a blank white screen).

file_operations.description: Create a verification script that fetches https://areaworkars.caffeine.ai and fails if the response is non-success or if the HTML does not include the expected app shell marker (e.g., the root mount element id='root' from frontend/index.html).
Wire the post-deploy verification script to run immediately after the live deployment step so failures are detected right away and the overall script exits non-zero if verification fails.
Document the post-deploy verification step and the expected pass/fail behavior (including that it validates reachability and app shell rendering at https://areaworkars.caffeine.ai).
